Zambia’s Copperfield Mining Appoints Nchimunya Mwansa as New Chief Executive Officer

LUSAKA, June 14 – Copperfield Mining, one of Zambia’s leading metals and mining firms, announced Thursday the appointment of Nchimunya Mwansa as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective July 1. Mwansa, who has served for over a decade in executive roles across the mining sector, is set to become the first Zambian woman to lead the company.

Mwansa succeeds outgoing CEO Jean-Paul Moreau, who is retiring after six years in the position. The board praised Moreau’s leadership, which saw Copperfield Mining expand its copper output by 18% and invest heavily in local community development projects.

“We are delighted to welcome Ms. Mwansa to Copperfield Mining,” said board chair Linda Chileshe in a statement. “Her extensive experience in mineral extraction and her deep commitment to sustainable practices make her exceptionally qualified to guide the company through its next phase of growth.”

Mwansa, 48, previously served as Chief Operating Officer at North Star Minerals, overseeing operations at three major Zambian copper sites. Industry analysts said her appointment reflects a broader push for local leadership and gender diversity in Zambia’s mining industry, which accounts for about 70% of the country’s export earnings.

“Her track record speaks for itself, and her leadership comes at a critical time as Zambia works to boost output and attract more foreign investment,” said Joseph Mulenga, an independent mining analyst in Lusaka.

The Zambia Chamber of Mines congratulated Mwansa on her appointment. “This is a milestone for our sector and for women in mining,” said Chamber spokesperson Grace Kalaba. “We look forward to continued collaboration with Copperfield Mining under her stewardship.”

Mwansa said her immediate priorities include increasing production efficiency and strengthening community engagement. “I am honored by the trust placed in me,” she said in a statement. “Together with the team, I aim to enhance Copperfield’s role as a responsible and innovative industry leader.”

Copperfield Mining employs over 3,000 people and operates multiple sites in Zambia’s Copperbelt and North-Western Province.
